title: Rabbi Ada son of Rabbi Shimon
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Megillah 1:9, speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. This statement is in Berakhot, chapter 2, end of halakhah 3, where it reads Rabbi Idi son of Rabbi Shimon. And where it cites there “Rabbi Idi in the name of Rabbi Shimon in the name of Rabbi Yochanan — in the name of Rabbi Yesa,” Hyman proposes reading Rabbi Idi son of Rabbi Shimon.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3 has both an attribution by Idi in the name of Shimon and a separate occurrence of Idi son of Shimon. Hyman proposes the patronym in the former.
